description: This is a JavaScript source file defining a front-end page component for a furniture shopping app. It utilizes the Blits library for declarative UI component creation, manages state, subscriptions, and renders a grid of product cards along with header, cart button, and checkout modal.

classes.name: Home
classes.description: A Blits component representing the home page with product grid, header, cart button, and checkout modal.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Returns the initial state object for the component, including layout sizes, messages, and modal visibility.

methods.name: watchers
methods.description: Defines watchers for width and height to update content dimensions dynamically.

methods.name: subscriptions
methods.description: Sets up store subscription to update layout and messages based on product list, loading, error, and checkout state.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Initializes component dimensions, sets up initial layout, and loads products if not already loaded.
